chant.letra:
[Leader]
A whale and a snail — which is bigger?
[Kids]
The whale! The whale is bigger than the snail!

[Leader]
A panda and a bat — which is bigger?
[Kids]
The panda! The bat is smaller!

[Leader]
A shark and a dolphin — which is faster?
[Kids]
Both are fast! Both are fast!

[Leader]
And which of them needs help?
[Kids]
All of them! Protect them all!

[All]
Lion, penguin, parrot, kangaroo —
bigger, smaller, we protect you!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
A whale is bigger than a snail,
a shark is faster than a bat.
A panda's slower than a parrot
and a lion knows it, just like that.

[Chorus]
Bigger than, smaller than,
louder than, slower than!
Every animal has its size
and every one has a plan!

[Verse 2]
Sofía's map says where they live,
Erik counts the penguins on the ice.
Some are endangered, some are gone —
extinct is not a word that's nice.

[Chorus]
Bigger than, smaller than,
louder than, slower than!
Every animal has its size
and every one has a plan!

[Bridge]
The climate changes, so do we:
protect the land, protect the sea.

[Chorus]
Bigger than, smaller than,
louder than, slower than!
Every animal has its size
and every one has a plan!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
What's the weather like today?
[Kids]
It's sunny! Hot and sunny!

[Leader]
What's the weather like today?
[Kids]
It's rainy! Cold and rainy!

[Leader]
What's the weather like today?
[Kids]
It's windy! Hold your hat!

[Leader]
And after the storm?
[Kids]
A rainbow! A rainbow over the fjord!

[All]
Sunny, cloudy, snowy, foggy —
ask again tomorrow!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Mateo lost his scarf again,
the wind took it down the street.
It's stormy on the water
and it's cold around his feet.

[Chorus]
What's the weather like today?
Ask the sky and it will say!
Sunny, rainy, windy, snowy —
dress for it and come and play!

[Verse 2]
It's foggy on the mountain road,
it's cloudy on the hill.
It's hot inside the kitchen
where Valentina's cooking still.

[Chorus]
What's the weather like today?
Ask the sky and it will say!
Sunny, rainy, windy, snowy —
dress for it and come and play!

[Bridge]
And when the rain has gone away,
a rainbow ends a rainy day.

[Chorus]
What's the weather like today?
Ask the sky and it will say!
Sunny, rainy, windy, snowy —
dress for it and come and play!

03.gramatica: past simple: went / saw / had / rode / won

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Today I go —
[Kids]
yesterday I WENT!

[Leader]
Today I see —
[Kids]
yesterday I SAW!

[Leader]
Today I have —
[Kids]
yesterday I HAD!

[Leader]
Today I ride —
[Kids]
yesterday I RODE!

[Leader]
Today I eat —
[Kids]
yesterday I ATE!

[Leader]
Today I win —
[Kids]
yesterday I WON!

[All]
Went, saw, had, rode, ate, won —
yesterday at the funfair, everyone!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Yesterday we went to the funfair,
yesterday we saw the big wheel turn.
Mateo had a ticket in his pocket —
he lost it twice, but he never learns!

[Chorus]
Went, saw, had —
yesterday, yesterday!
Rode, ate, won —
what a day, what a day!

[Verse 2]
Sofía rode the horses round and round,
Erik ate a hot dog on the way.
Valentina won a giant panda —
she couldn't even carry it away!

[Chorus]
Went, saw, had —
yesterday, yesterday!
Rode, ate, won —
what a day, what a day!

[Bridge]
Today is today and today we say GO,
but when it's finished we say WENT.
Today we SEE, and after that
we tell the story: yesterday we SAW.

[Chorus — final]
Went, saw, had —
yesterday, yesterday!
Rode, ate, won —
what a day, what a day!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
I wake up — then what?
[Kids]
You get up! You get up!

[Leader]
I get up — then what?
[Kids]
You wash! You brush your teeth!

[Leader]
I brush — then what?
[Kids]
You get dressed! Comb your hair!

[Leader]
I'm dressed — then what?
[Kids]
Have breakfast! Catch the bus!

[All]
Wake up, wash, get dressed, go —
that's a morning, now you know!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
I wake up when the light comes in,
I get up and I wash my face.
The towel's wet, the toothbrush waits,
my toothpaste never stays in place.

[Chorus]
Wake up, get dressed, have breakfast,
grab your bag and run!
Catch the bus, don't miss the bus —
the morning's nearly done!

[Verse 2]
Erik combs his hair with a fork
because he cannot find the comb.
Mateo does his homework late
and leaves his notebook back at home.

[Chorus]
Wake up, get dressed, have breakfast,
grab your bag and run!
Catch the bus, don't miss the bus —
the morning's nearly done!

[Bridge]
Every day, the same way —
that's what 'every morning' means.

[Chorus]
Wake up, get dressed, have breakfast,
grab your bag and run!
Catch the bus, don't miss the bus —
the morning's nearly done!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
The doctor — what does she wear?
[Kids]
A white shirt! A white shirt!

[Leader]
The firefighter — what does he wear?
[Kids]
Big boots! Big yellow boots!

[Leader]
The baker — what does she wear?
[Kids]
A cap! A cap and gloves!

[Leader]
And you, on a cold day?
[Kids]
A jumper! A scarf! And socks!

[All]
Jacket, trousers, skirt and shirt —
everybody wears their work!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
The vet wears gloves to hold a cat,
the teacher wears a jumper, blue.
The librarian wears a scarf all winter
and the baker wears white too.

[Chorus]
What do you wear? What do you wear?
Boots and trousers, cap and shirt!
Every job, a different jacket —
every day, a different skirt!

[Verse 2]
The police officer wears a hat,
the firefighter wears the heaviest coat.
The doctor keeps her socks bright red
and nobody ever knows.

[Chorus]
What do you wear? What do you wear?
Boots and trousers, cap and shirt!
Every job, a different jacket —
every day, a different skirt!

[Bridge]
What will you wear when you are grown?
Choose the job and choose the clothes.

[Chorus]
What do you wear? What do you wear?
Boots and trousers, cap and shirt!
Every job, a different jacket —
every day, a different skirt!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Pasta!
[Kids]
I like pasta! Tasty pasta!

[Leader]
Soup!
[Kids]
I like soup! Hot, hot soup!

[Leader]
Salad!
[Kids]
I don't like salad! No, no, no!

[Leader]
Milkshake!
[Kids]
YES! I love a milkshake!

[All]
Rice and cheese and sausage too —
vegetables and meat for you!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Valentina likes her rice with cheese,
Sofía likes a bowl of soup.
Erik likes a sausage sandwich
and he eats it with the group.

[Chorus]
I like, I don't like —
say it and be true!
Pasta, salad, meat and milkshake,
what is tasty to you?

[Verse 2]
After geography and biology,
after chemistry and drama too,
everybody's hungry
and the vegetables look new.

[Chorus]
I like, I don't like —
say it and be true!
Pasta, salad, meat and milkshake,
what is tasty to you?

[Bridge]
Don't say 'yuck' and walk away —
try one bite, then have your say.

[Chorus]
I like, I don't like —
say it and be true!
Pasta, salad, meat and milkshake,
what is tasty to you?

chant.letra:
[Leader]
How many lemons?
[Kids]
Three lemons in the basket!

[Leader]
How many carrots?
[Kids]
Six carrots, orange carrots!

[Leader]
How much is the coconut?
[Kids]
Too much! Too much!

[Leader]
And the beans?
[Kids]
Cheap! Cheap! We'll take them all!

[All]
Grapes and pears and onions, kiwi —
fill the basket, come with me!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Past the bakery, past the post office,
past the vet's clinic on the square,
the market opens up on Saturday
and everybody's there.

[Chorus]
How much? How many?
Fill the basket, count them out!
Grapes and pears and kiwi, lemons —
that is what the market's about!

[Verse 2]
Sofía wants a coconut,
Mateo drops the potatoes twice.
Two onions and a bag of beans
and one small carrot: that's the price.

[Chorus]
How much? How many?
Fill the basket, count them out!
Grapes and pears and kiwi, lemons —
that is what the market's about!

[Bridge]
The fire station rings its bell,
the community centre's full as well.

[Chorus]
How much? How many?
Fill the basket, count them out!
Grapes and pears and kiwi, lemons —
that is what the market's about!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
In my bedroom — what is there?
[Kids]
There is a bed! There is a desk!

[Leader]
On the wall — what is there?
[Kids]
There is a poster! There is a clock!

[Leader]
And in the wardrobe?
[Kids]
There are shoes! There are too many shoes!

[Leader]
And in the hall?
[Kids]
There is Luna, fast asleep!

[All]
Kitchen, bathroom, living room —
there is space for everyone!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
There is a desk beside the window,
there are notes all over the bed.
There is a poster of a mountain
and a clock above my head.

[Chorus]
There is one, there are two —
look around and say what's true!
Bedroom, kitchen, hall and bathroom,
this is home, and home is you.

[Verse 2]
Erik has to hand in Monday,
so he has to concentrate.
He takes notes and then revises
and the wardrobe door won't shut, it's late.

[Chorus]
There is one, there are two —
look around and say what's true!
Bedroom, kitchen, hall and bathroom,
this is home, and home is you.

[Bridge]
One thing: 'there is'. More: 'there are'.
Say it right and you'll go far.

[Chorus]
There is one, there are two —
look around and say what's true!
Bedroom, kitchen, hall and bathroom,
this is home, and home is you.

chant.letra:
[Leader]
What is Sofía doing?
[Kids]
She is digging! She is digging now!

[Leader]
What is Erik doing?
[Kids]
He is watering the plants!

[Leader]
What is the bee doing?
[Kids]
It is flying! Round the flower!

[Leader]
And what is the tree doing?
[Kids]
Growing! Slowly growing!

[All]
Grass and leaf and flower and tree —
everything is growing, look and see!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Sofía is digging in the grass,
a butterfly is passing by.
Erik's watering the little plant
and a bee is climbing to the sky.

[Chorus]
What is happening right now?
Something's growing, that is how!
Leaf and flower, tree and seed —
water, sunshine, that's all they need!

[Verse 2]
At the zoo the penguin's walking,
the flamingo's standing on one leg.
The giraffe is reaching for a leaf
and the crocodile won't beg.

[Chorus]
What is happening right now?
Something's growing, that is how!
Leaf and flower, tree and seed —
water, sunshine, that's all they need!

[Bridge]
Not yesterday and not next year:
'-ing' means it's happening here.

[Chorus]
What is happening right now?
Something's growing, that is how!
Leaf and flower, tree and seed —
water, sunshine, that's all they need!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Can a duck swim?
[Kids]
Yes, it can! Across the field!

[Leader]
Can a cow jump?
[Kids]
No, it can't! It cannot jump!

[Leader]
Can a horse run?
[Kids]
Yes, it can! Fast, fast, fast!

[Leader]
Can a hen give milk?
[Kids]
No! An egg! A hen gives eggs!

[All]
Sheep and goat and donkey too —
every animal has its job to do!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Sofía's grandfather Pablo
opens up the field at eight.
The cow gives milk, the hen gives eggs,
the donkey's always late.

[Chorus]
It can run and it can't fly,
it can swim and it can't climb!
Cow and sheep and goat and horse —
everybody in good time!

[Verse 2]
A carnivore eats meat, they say,
a herbivore eats grass all day.
The predator is far from here —
the prey can rest and stay.

[Chorus]
It can run and it can't fly,
it can swim and it can't climb!
Cow and sheep and goat and horse —
everybody in good time!

[Bridge]
What can you do that they can't?
Say it loud and say it now!

[Chorus]
It can run and it can't fly,
it can swim and it can't climb!
Cow and sheep and goat and horse —
everybody in good time!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Let's go to the lake!
[Kids]
To the lake! To the cold, cold lake!

[Leader]
Let's take the boat!
[Kids]
Take the boat! Row, row, row!

[Leader]
Let's have a picnic!
[Kids]
On the rock! Beside the forest!

[Leader]
Let's swim!
[Kids]
Jump! Jump! It's freezing!

[All]
Lake and forest, rock and fish —
mountain day, that's all we wish!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Let's walk up to the mountain lake,
let's put the picnic on a rock.
The forest is behind us
and the water's like a shock.

[Chorus]
Let's swim, let's jump,
let's row the boat away!
Cold lake, warm day —
let's stay, let's stay!

[Verse 2]
The jungle's hot, the desert's dry,
the arctic's white and far.
The ocean, savanna, rainforest —
but here is where we are.

[Chorus]
Let's swim, let's jump,
let's row the boat away!
Cold lake, warm day —
let's stay, let's stay!

[Bridge]
Luna barks and jumps straight in —
a husky doesn't mind the cold.

[Chorus]
Let's swim, let's jump,
let's row the boat away!
Cold lake, warm day —
let's stay, let's stay!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Have you got a ruler?
[Kids]
Yes, I have! In my pencil case!

[Leader]
Have you got a rubber?
[Kids]
Yes, I have! A little one!

[Leader]
Has Mateo got his notebook?
[Kids]
No, he hasn't! Not again!

[Leader]
What has he got?
[Kids]
Glue! Scissors! And a sharpener!

[All]
Crayons, compass, calculator —
in the backpack, find them later!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
I have got a pencil case,
I have got a ruler too.
Mateo's got a sharpener
and a diary from last June.

[Chorus]
Have you got it? Has she got it?
Look inside the backpack!
Glue and scissors, crayons, rubber —
put them all straight back!

[Verse 2]
Erik's got a calculator
and a compass he designed.
Mateo's got no notebook —
he has got the wrong one, every time.

[Chorus]
Have you got it? Has she got it?
Look inside the backpack!
Glue and scissors, crayons, rubber —
put them all straight back!

[Bridge]
'I have got' and 'she has got' —
one small change and that's the lot.

[Chorus]
Have you got it? Has she got it?
Look inside the backpack!
Glue and scissors, crayons, rubber —
put them all straight back!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
We must listen!
[Kids]
We must listen!

[Leader]
We must raise our hand!
[Kids]
Raise your hand!

[Leader]
We mustn't shout!
[Kids]
We mustn't shout!

[Leader]
We mustn't run!
[Kids]
We mustn't run inside!

[Leader]
And what must we always do?
[Kids]
Share! Help! Respect!

[All]
Quiet, tidy, hand up high —
that's the rule and that is why!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
In maths you must show all your working,
in science you must wear the coat.
In art you mustn't take my scissors,
in music you must find the note.

[Chorus]
Must, must, mustn't, mustn't —
the rule is simple, that is all!
Listen, share, respect and tidy,
raise your hand and never shout down the hall!

[Verse 2]
In PE you must warm up first,
in English you must try out loud.
In history you must ask questions —
asking questions makes us proud.

[Chorus]
Must, must, mustn't, mustn't —
the rule is simple, that is all!
Listen, share, respect and tidy,
raise your hand and never shout down the hall!

[Bridge]
A rule is not to spoil your day —
it's how thirty people find a way.

[Chorus]
Must, must, mustn't, mustn't —
the rule is simple, that is all!
Listen, share, respect and tidy,
raise your hand and never shout down the hall!
